breakdown.heading: A few real-world factors.
breakdown.description: I keep pricing straightforward. The fastest way to confirm your range is a short description and a few photos.

drivers.title: Yard size + layout
drivers.description: More area, more edges, more time. Layout matters too (beds, paths, slopes, tight corners).

drivers.title: Current condition
drivers.description: Light tidy-ups are quicker. Heavy overgrowth, thick weeds, or neglected beds take longer and need more handling.

drivers.title: Access
drivers.description: Easy access keeps things efficient. Stairs, narrow gates, long carries, or limited parking can increase time.

drivers.title: Green waste handling
drivers.description: Bagging, stacking, or removal changes the workload. I'll confirm what you want done with clippings.

breakdown.tipBody: Include photos from a few angles, plus any access notes (gates, stairs, parking).

items.q: Is the calculator a fixed quote?
items.a: No, it gives a rough guide based on typical pricing. I’ll confirm the exact cost after reviewing photos of your garden and understanding access, condition, and what’s included. Most quotes are sent within 24 hours.

items.q: What’s the fastest way to get an accurate estimate?
items.a: Send a few photos from different angles along with a short description of what you need. Mention any access details like narrow gates, steps, or parking. I’ll usually have a quote back to you within 24 hours.

items.q: Do you charge differently for one-off vs ongoing maintenance?
items.a: Ongoing maintenance is generally more efficient because the garden stays under control between visits, so each session takes less time. One-off jobs can take longer depending on how overgrown things are. Regular visits typically start from around £60 per session.

Quilliams is an Environment Agency registered waste carrier (lower tier), CBDL582202. Green waste removal is £10 per dumpy bag and is included in most quotes. I’ll always confirm upfront whether removal is part of the price or listed separately so there are no surprises.

items.q: Can you work within a budget range?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. If you share a rough budget I can prioritise the highest-impact work first and save the rest for later. Many customers start with a cleanup and add extra work over time as the garden improves.
